package nats

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"time"

	natsgo "github.com/nats-io/nats.go"
	"go.uber.org/zap"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
)

const (
	LearningAnalyticsEventsStream = "LEARNING_ANALYTICS_EVENTS"
	LearningActivityQueue         = "ms-teacher-learning-activity"
	LearningActivityDurable       = "ms-teacher-learning-activity-v1"
)

type learningActivityEnvelope struct {
	SchemaVersion int                  `json:"schema_version"`
	EventID       string               `json:"event_id"`
	EventType     string               `json:"event_type"`
	CorrelationID string               `json:"correlation_id"`
	StudentID     string               `json:"student_id"`
	OccurredAt    time.Time            `json:"occurred_at"`
	Data          learningActivityData `json:"data"`
}

type learningActivityData struct {
	EventID             string    `json:"event_id"`
	StudentID           string    `json:"student_id"`
	AnalyticsSessionID  string    `json:"analytics_session_id"`
	CourseID            string    `json:"course_id"`
	LessonID            string    `json:"lesson_id"`
	TaskID              string    `json:"task_id"`
	SignalType          string    `json:"signal_type"`
	ConsecutiveFailures int       `json:"consecutive_failures"`
	SameErrorCount      int       `json:"same_error_count"`
	ActiveSeconds       int       `json:"active_seconds"`
	IdleSeconds         int       `json:"idle_seconds"`
	Progressing         bool      `json:"progressing"`
	ErrorFingerprint    string    `json:"error_fingerprint"`
	OccurredAt          time.Time `json:"occurred_at"`
}

func DecodeLearningActivityInteresting(payload []byte) (domain.LearningActivitySignal, error) {
	var envelope learningActivityEnvelope
	if err := decodeStrictJSON(payload, &envelope); err != nil {
		return domain.LearningActivitySignal{}, fmt.Errorf("decode interesting learning activity: %w", err)
	}
	if envelope.SchemaVersion != domain.LearningActivitySchemaVersion || envelope.EventType != domain.SubjectLearningActivityInteresting ||
		envelope.EventID != envelope.Data.EventID || envelope.StudentID != envelope.Data.StudentID ||
		envelope.CorrelationID != envelope.Data.AnalyticsSessionID || !envelope.OccurredAt.Equal(envelope.Data.OccurredAt) {
		return domain.LearningActivitySignal{}, errors.New("inconsistent interesting learning activity envelope")
	}
	return domain.NewLearningActivitySignal(domain.LearningActivitySignal{
		EventID: envelope.EventID, StudentID: envelope.StudentID, AnalyticsSessionID: envelope.CorrelationID,
		CourseID: envelope.Data.CourseID, LessonID: envelope.Data.LessonID, TaskID: envelope.Data.TaskID,
		SignalType: envelope.Data.SignalType, ConsecutiveFailures: envelope.Data.ConsecutiveFailures,
		SameErrorCount: envelope.Data.SameErrorCount, ActiveSeconds: envelope.Data.ActiveSeconds,
		IdleSeconds: envelope.Data.IdleSeconds, Progressing: envelope.Data.Progressing, OccurredAt: envelope.OccurredAt,
	})
}

type LearningActivitySubscriber struct {
	Conn       *natsgo.Conn
	Handler    func(context.Context, domain.LearningActivitySignal) (bool, error)
	Logger     *zap.Logger
	AckWait    time.Duration
	RetryDelay time.Duration
}

func (subscriber LearningActivitySubscriber) Subscribe(ctx context.Context) error {
	if subscriber.Conn == nil || subscriber.Handler == nil {
		return errors.New("learning activity subscriber connection and handler are required")
	}
	logger := subscriber.Logger
	if logger == nil {
		logger = zap.NewNop()
	}
	ackWait := subscriber.AckWait
	if ackWait <= 0 {
		ackWait = 30 * time.Second
	}
	retryDelay := subscriber.RetryDelay
	if retryDelay <= 0 {
		retryDelay = 5 * time.Second
	}
	jetStream, err := subscriber.Conn.JetStream()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_, err = jetStream.QueueSubscribe(
		domain.SubjectLearningActivityInteresting,
		LearningActivityQueue,
		func(message *natsgo.Msg) {
			signal, decodeErr := DecodeLearningActivityInteresting(message.Data)
			if decodeErr != nil {
				logger.Warn("terminate invalid interesting learning activity", zap.Error(decodeErr))
				_ = message.Term()
				return
			}
			processed, handleErr := subscriber.Handler(ctx, signal)
			if handleErr != nil {
				logger.Warn("retry interesting learning activity", zap.String("event_id", signal.EventID), zap.Error(handleErr))
				_ = message.NakWithDelay(retryDelay)
				return
			}
			if ackErr := message.AckSync(); ackErr != nil {
				logger.Warn("ack interesting learning activity", zap.String("event_id", signal.EventID), zap.Error(ackErr))
				return
			}
			logger.Debug("interesting learning activity handled", zap.String("event_id", signal.EventID), zap.Bool("processed", processed))
		},
		natsgo.BindStream(LearningAnalyticsEventsStream), natsgo.Durable(LearningActivityDurable),
		natsgo.ManualAck(), natsgo.AckExplicit(), natsgo.DeliverAll(), natsgo.AckWait(ackWait),
	)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return subscriber.Conn.FlushTimeout(5 * time.Second)
}
